name: OpenGL GPU Multi Volume Ray Cast Mapper
aliases: OpenGL GPU Multi-Volume Ray Casting Mapper
definition: A concrete OpenGL implementation of a ray cast image display helper, responsible for drawing the volume ray cast image to the screen.
summary: The OpenGL GPU Multi Volume Ray Cast Mapper is an OpenGL-specific subclass that manages hardware extensions, object lifecycle, and clipping to render multiple volumes simultaneously via GPU-accelerated ray casting.
